description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelEmailLink class, which extends SugarWidgetField and provides a method to generate email composition links in the subpanel view within the SuiteCRM system. It interacts with EmailUI to populate compose view fields based on context.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelEmailLink
classes.description: A widget class for rendering email links in subpanels, extending SugarWidgetField.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates an email link for the specified record or user, using EmailUI to prepare the compose view. It checks context variables to determine which entity to use for email composition.
